source.label: Samsung Electronics 2026 Half-year Business Report, I.4.A Total number of shares
source.quote: As of the same date, issued shares and shares outstanding totaled 5,764,191,903 for common shares and 802,371,203 for preferred shares. ... V. Treasury shares 82,086,705 - 82,086,705 - VI. Outstanding shares 5,764,191,903 802,371,203 6,566,563,106 -

notes: Common shares only, priced on the Korea Exchange line 005930.KS in KRW, net of 82,086,705 treasury shares, from the 2026 half-year business report (June 30, 2026), the latest Samsung has published in English (no third-quarter report is on its IR site yet). Judgment call: Samsung's 802,371,203 non-voting preferred shares (listed separately as 005935.KS, with an extra 1%-of-par dividend) are left out under the common-equity-only rule, although they share in earnings much like common shares; including them would add about 12% to the share count at the preferred line's own price.
